details.description: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite is Google DeepMind's cost-efficient, low-latency model in the Gemini 3 series, published July 21, 2026 and built on Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite. It is optimized for high-volume, latency-sensitive tasks such as translation, classification and document processing, while also supporting agentic workflows, and accepts text, image, audio and video input over up to a 1M-token context window. Google states its knowledge cutoff is March 2026, though for some domains its knowledge is limited to January 2025, in line with the wider Gemini 3 model family.
advantages: Scores 74.0% on OSWorld-Verified, an agentic computer-use benchmark, per Google DeepMind's model card.
Scores 76.5% on CharXiv Reasoning, a chart-based information synthesis benchmark, with tools, per Google DeepMind's model card.
Scores 72.2% on the GDM-MRCR v2 8-needle long-context benchmark at 128k tokens, per Google DeepMind's model card.
Scores 54.2% on SWE-Bench Pro, a diverse agentic coding benchmark, per Google DeepMind's model card.
Scores 39.2% on MLE-Bench, a machine-learning-engineering benchmark, per Google DeepMind's model card.
disadvantages: Text-only output; does not generate audio or images, per Google's Gemini API model documentation.
Knowledge cutoff of March 2026, with some domains limited to January 2025, per Google DeepMind's model card.
No Live API support, per Google's Gemini API model documentation.
use_cases: High-volume, latency-sensitive tasks such as translation and classification
Coding tasks and complex video reasoning

notes: Catalog's deprecation_date (2027-07-21) does not match Google's Gemini deprecations page, which as of its September 23, 2026 update lists gemini-3.5-flash-lite's release date as July 21, 2026 with 'No shutdown date announced'; kept the catalog's value per instructions since it disagrees with the source. Other catalog facts match: 1,048,576 input / 65,536 output tokens matches the model card's 1M input / 64K output tokens, and gemini + vertex_ai-gemini-models match its Gemini API and Google Cloud distribution. Elo-style benchmarks (GDPVal-AA v2) were excluded as not accuracy scores.
